description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Treasury Operations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-10-21 to appoint Mr. Jude Nilukshan, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as the Director General of Budget, to act in the Post of Director General of the Department of Treasury Operations, which has become vacant due to the appointment of Mr. A.N. Hapugala, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Accountants' Service, who served as the Director General of the Department of Treasury Operations, to a post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury. Based on the recommendations submitted by a Committee consisting of two Deputy Secretaries to the Treasury appointed by the Secretary to the Treasury, Mrs. A.M.S. Malkanthi, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Accountants' Service, presently serving as the Additional Director General of the Department of Public Finance, has been identified as a suitable officer to be appointed to the post of Director General of the Department of Treasury Operations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to appoint Mrs. A.M.S. Malkanthi to the Post of Director General of the Department of Treasury Operations with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Coast Guard
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The post of Director General of the Department of Coast Guard is vacant at present, upon the retirement of Mr. Y.R. Serasinghe, from the public service on 2025-10-07 on completion of the age of 55 years. Rear Admiral R. Joseph, who has completed 31 years of service in the Sri Lanka Navy, has been identified as a suitable officer for the said post. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to appoint him to the post of Director General of the Department of Coast Guard, with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Legal Empowerment of the Implementation Mechanism of the 'Praja Shakthi', the National Movement to Eradicate Poverty
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-02-24 to implement the 'Praja Shakthi', the National Movement to Eradicate Poverty in accordance with the National Policy, 'A Thriving Nation, A Beautiful Life'. This campaign is being implemented as a people-centred initiative, and a National Policy Council and a National Steering Committee have been established for the same. This programme will be implemented within an integrated structure of Ministries, Provincial Councils, District Secretariats and Divisional Secretariats, and will cover the entire island, including activities such as identification of grassroots-level issues, formulation of programmes, project planning, monitoring, progress review, social auditing, and obtaining community participation for follow-up of ongoing projects. At the dialogues held with the stakeholders involved in this National Movement, the need for legal empowerment by an Act of Parliament has been pointed out. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to legally empower the implementation mechanism of the 'Praja Shakthi', the National Movement to Eradicate Poverty, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project to construct permanent houses for the families displaced due to the conflict situation in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - 919,450 people belonging to 277,167 families have been resettled in their original villages by providing permanent houses to displaced families in the Northern and Eastern Provinces from 2009 to 2025-12-31. As of 2026-01-01, it has been identified that there are still 13,069 displaced families in those Provinces who do not own any house. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to allocate Rs.900, 000 to construct a house of 340 sq.ft for displaced families of two or less than two members and Rs.1,500,000 to construct a house of 550 sq.ft  for families with more than two members, as grants. At a progress review meeting held on 2026-01-02 under the chairmanship of the Hon. President regarding this project, taking into account the fact that the beneficiaries are low-income earners and there is an increase in the cost of relevant construction materials and labor costs, it was identified as appropriate to increase the current grant amount paid, to Rs.2 million for a house of 550 sq.ft, regardless of the number of family members, from the year 2026, enabling to the construct the relevant houses to the prescribed standard. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to increase the current grant amount provided under this project to Rs.2 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of Electric Drills for Neuro Surgery
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of electric drills used in brain surgeries and various neuro surgeries, and 02 bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendations of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, following the evaluation of the said bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement for the supply of 10 electric drills to Aesculap AG (Manufacturer: Aesculap Ag) of Germany, the substantially responsive lowest bidder, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of the Base Hospital-Deniyaya by constructing a hospital with 300 beds (Budget Proposals-2026)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Deniyaya Base Hospital, with a capacity of 137 beds, provides specialist medical services in medicine, surgery, gynecology and obstetrics and pediatrics, as well as ophthalmology, dermatology, psychiatry, radiology, laboratory, forensic medicine, clinical, emergency care, health education and primary health care services to a population of about 70,000 in various Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Matara, Galle and Ratnapura Districts. The high altitude, steep slopes and heavy rainfall available in the Deniyaya area, have resulted in a high risk of landslides and the front area of the emergency care unit and the OPD, as well as the area around the maternity unit of the hospital, were affected by landslides in 2023 and 2024. Therefore, it has been proposed to relocate the entire hospital at a suitable and safe location by constructing a new hospital with 300 beds at a newly identified location. For the purpose, a portion of land has been acquired by the Southern Provincial Health Department from the Handford Estate, located about 03 km from the city. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to construct a new hospital with 300 beds in the said land at an estimated cost of Rs.6,000 million under 02 phases and relocate the Deniyaya Base Hospital, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Health and Medical Service Improvement Project carried out with the funds of the Japan International Cooperation Agency
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Improving access to cardiac care facilities, including cardiac catheterization, has been identified as one of the key functions to be followed in the treatment of noncommunicable diseases, a priority area identified to be addressed in the National Health Master Plan. Cardiac catheterization facilities are currently available in only a few government hospitals in Sri Lanka. A Health and Medical Services Improvement Project was initiated in 2018 with the approval of the Cabinet with the aim of improving medical services for cardiovascular diseases, diagnosis and related treatment. Under the original scope of the said project, which was implemented under the funding of 10,639 million Japanese Yen provided by the Japan International Cooperation Agency, it has been planned to construct cardiac catheterization units, cardiac intensive care units, cardiac operating theaters, cardio-thoracic theaters, general cardiac wards, equipment and buildings in 05 major tertiary hospitals namely, Kandy National Hospital, Anuradhapura Teaching Hospital, Kurunegala Teaching Hospital, Badulla Teaching Hospital and Trincomalee District General Hospital. However, due to the economic crisis that occurred in the year 2022, the project could not be completed on time and the project has been stopped midway. Also, due to the increase in the prices of construction materials and related services, the total cost estimate for the implementation of the entire project has increased by Japanese Yen 2,833 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to re-implement the said project, subject to revising the scope of the project and extending the project period until 2029-12-31, taking into account the available funds for the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the Passenger and Ramp Handling Services of SriLankan Airlines at the Bangalore Airport (BLR) in India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the limited international competitive bidding procedure for the provision of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services of SriLankan Airlines at the Bangalore Airport in India. Three (03) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation, to award the said Passenger and Ramp Handling Services contract, to GlobeGround India Pvt. Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of US$ 3.093 million, for a period of three years from 2026-04-01 to 2029-03-31, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting the housing units of the Colombage Mawatha and Stadiumgama Apartment complexes being constructed under phase 2 of the Colombo Urban Regeneration Project, to the eligible beneficiaries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - With the objective of addressing the housing requirements of the communities living in underprivileged settlements in the Colombo City, the Urban Development Authority, under the guidance of the Government, has initiated the Urban Regeneration Project. As the second phase of this project, the Support to Colombo Urban Regeneration Project has been initiated. Under the said project, the construction of 4,074 housing units in 06 apartment complexes centered in the areas of Colombage Mawatha, Stadiumgama, Ferguson, Apple watte, Madampitiya and Obeysekarapura has commenced, and funds amounting to US$ 158 million have been obtained from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank for this purpose. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to provide the relevant entitlements and benefits to the eligible low-income settlement owners in accordance with the social safeguard guidelines of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, to charge an amount of Rs.350,000/- as a nominal value from the capital cost of the apartment and an amount of  Rs.50,000/- as the contribution to the Sinking Fund created for the maintenance of the housing complex from each housing recipient and to grant them ownership of the relevant houses, subject to the other expenses including the charges for the issuance of title deeds and notary fees relating to the transferring of houses, be borne by the Government.

description: Hosting the inaugural meeting of the BIMSTEC Expert Group on Fiscal Monetary Policy in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) has been established to promote regional cooperation and economic integration in the Bay of Bengal region. At a discussion held in February 2024 in coincidence with the 7th Indian Ocean Conference, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka has proposed to establish an 'Expert Group on Fiscal and Monetary Policy' in order to facilitate the exchange of expertise and experience among Member States on the formulation and implementation of fiscal and monetary policies. Approval of the Ministers of all Member States has been received for the Concept Note on the Establishment of the Expert Group, prepared in accordance with the said proposal. The BIMSTEC Secretariat, through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, has officially requested Sri Lanka to consider holding the inaugural meeting of the said Expert Group in Sri Lanka so that the Terms of Reference and the Action Plan of the said Expert Group can be prepared. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to hold the inaugural meeting of the said Expert Group in Sri Lanka in 2026, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Substitution of the term 'Fine Aggregate' in place of the term 'River Sand' in respect of the Construction Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The construction industry is currently facing a shortage of river sand due to restrictions on river sand mining in environmentally sensitive areas and restrictions on sand transportation. As a result, the prices of river sand have increased rapidly, causing substantial financial pressure on both Government and Private sector construction projects. Therefore, it has been found appropriate to use the broad term 'Fine Aggregate' to cover all those materials, including manufactured sand (M-sand), crushed rock fines, offshore sand and other suitable materials as alternatives for river sand, in order to facilitate their systematic identification and use. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to promulgate the Regulations in terms of the provisions of the Construction Industry Development Act, No.33 of 2014, enabling to define the above mentioned mineral materials that can be sifted through a 4 mm sieve as 'Fine Aggregate', and to substitute the said term in place of the term River Sand' in all construction specifications and guidelines, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Yathiwara Mapiya Niwahana' National Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 'Yathiwara Mapiya Niwahana' National Programme has been designed to be implemented with the aim of building a house for homeless parents with economic difficulties who have offered their children to be ordained ensuring the continuous existence of the Buddhasasana. This programme is launched as an expression of religious gratitude to parents who have bequeathed their children to the Buddhasasana from families facing severe economic hardships. As the initial stage of the programme, it is planned to construct 1,000 houses covering every district of the island from 2026, and to implement the 'Yathiwara Mapiya Niwahana' National Programme as a subsidiary program of the 'A place of one's own-a beautiful life' housing programme being implemented by the Ministry of Housing, Construction and Water Supply. Beneficiaries identified under the proposed programme will be provided with a financial assistance of Rs.1.5 million for the construction of a new house as per the recommendations of the technical officers of the National Housing Development Authority, and maximum local level contribution will be made for the construction of houses. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs and the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to implement the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Liquidation of the Shrama Vasana Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Shrama Vasana Fund, which has the primary objective of providing financial assistance for the welfare of employees in the private and semigovernment sectors and making arrangements for matters incidental thereto, was established as per the provisions of the Shrama Vasana Fund Act, No.12 of 1998 and is currently under the purview of the Ministry of Labour. Review Report on Government-Owned Non-Commercial Institutions has identified the Shrama Vasana Fund as one of the institutions that should be deintervened in the management and liquidated, and has recommended its liquidation without prejudice to the parties currently benefiting from its services. An action plan has been prepared by a Committee comprising of various parties, identifying the functions to be performed further from among the functions performed by the said Fund, and obtaining views on the manner in which such functions should be implemented. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to take action to liquidate the Shrama Vasana Fund by 2026-06-30 in accordance with the provisions of the Finance Act, No.38 of 1971 and to continue to provide the services currently provided by the Shrama Vasana Fund and those that are not covered by any other institution, which should be continued, through the Ministry of Labour, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting a plot of land located at Kerawalapitiya, Wattala owned by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, to MAS Freight Wave Terminal (Private) Limited, on long term lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - M.A.S Consolidated (Private) Limited, a company engaged in logistics and storage ventures, has submitted a project proposal to grant a plot of land in extent of 3-4 acres at Kerawalapitiya, Wattala for the establishment of a logistics warehouse complex. The plot of land in extent 03 acres 02 roods 25.63 perches located at Kerawalapitiya has been identified as suitable for the said project. In accordance with the regulations of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka, a new company named MAS Freight Wave Terminal (Private) Limited has been established to implement the said new project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to grant the relevant plot of land to MAS Freight Wave Terminal (Private) Limited for a period of 30 years, subject to the payment of a lump sum of Rs.305.99 million in two installments and an annual nominal lease rent of Rs.90,000/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting a plot of land located at Kerawalapitiya, Wattala belonging to the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, to Powertech Products (Private) Limited, on long term lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A marshy land area in extent of approximately 400 acres located at Kerawalapitiya, Wattala, owned by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, has been developed at a considerable cost after pumping out offshore sand. A significant portion of the said developed land has been set apart for government as well as private investments of national importance approved by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka. DHT Cement (Private) Limited has made a request to obtain a land of about 3-5 acres in Kerawalapitiya, Wattala area, to establish a Board of Investment approved factory that produces fiber cement corrugated roofing sheets, fiber cement flat roofing sheets and accessories for the domestic and export markets. A new company named Powertech Products (Private) Limited has been established in accordance with the provisions of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka to implement the project, and the said Company has planned to invest US$ 7 million in the project. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to grant the plot of land in extent of 03 acres 01 rood 0.95 perches located at Wattala, Kerawalapitiya, owned by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, to Powertech Products (Private) Limited on lease basis for a period of 30 years for the said project, subject to making a lump sum payment of Rs.272.20 million and an annual nominal lease rent of Rs.83,500/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Digital Transformation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Digital Transformation Project, under the Digital Economy Strategy (2025 - 2030), has been prepared with a view to modernizing the delivery of public services efficiently and transparently through digital methods, which is a national policy priority. Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-10-21 to obtain the assistance of international development partners for the implementation of the said project. The loan negotiations initiated accordingly with the participation of all stakeholders of the Government of Sri Lanka and the World Bank Group for obtaining funds for the said project, have been concluded by now. According to the agreements reached at the said discussions, the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development will function as the borrower of the loan facility on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka, and GovTech Sri Lanka will act as the implementing agency for the implementation of the said project. The Ministry of Digital Economy has been entrusted with the policy oversight and inter-ministerial coordination in relation to the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to secure Special Drawing Rights (SDR) funds equivalent to US$ 50 million from the World Bank Group for the proposed project, based on the financial terms and conditions recommended by the Public Debt Management Office under the provisions of the Public Debt Management Act, No.33 of 2024, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing World Bank Funds through the Sri Lanka Programmatic for Growth, Resilience and Openness Development Policy Operation Series
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Securing Intermediary Financing receiving from multilateral development institutions such as the World Bank and the Asian Development Bank has been identified as an essential element of the Extended Fund Facility Programme. Accordingly, the Government of Sri Lanka has been provided with US$700 million by now, under the Resilience, Stability and Economic Turnaround (RESET) Development Policy Operation - 2023 - 2024 implemented under the World Bank funds to support fundamental reforms to facilitate the economic recovery and stability. The World Bank has agreed to provide US$ 400 million through the Sri Lanka Programmatic for Growth, Resilience and Openness Development Policy Operation Series, a three-year programme covering the period 2026 - 2028, with the aim of further supporting the country's structural reform agenda, enhancing Sri Lanka's competitiveness and openness, improving economic governance, and thereby fostering stronger and more sustainable growth. The operation has been structured under two main pillars: enhancing competitiveness and improving economic governance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to secure the relevant funding facility from the World Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accelerating the ''Gamata Sanniwedanay'' National Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 'Gamata Sanniwedanaya' Project, which aims to provide 4G broadband service facilities covering Sri Lanka by identifying areas that remain unserved and underserved and improving telecommunication services in such areas, has been implemented by the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka since 2021 under the provisions of the Finance Act, No.11 of 2004. As the key function of the said project, which is jointly implemented by mobile phone service providers and the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka, telecommunication towers are constructed through a cost-sharing mechanism. As of now, 83 telecommunication towers have been constructed by the service providers and mobile service facilities have been provided under the said project. Due to the economic crisis faced by Sri Lanka, the construction activities of the relevant towers have slowed down due to the increase in the operational costs of the service providers and the insufficient revenue generated by some telecommunication towers. However, taking into account the current trend of decreasing prices of equipment related to the construction of towers as well, the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka has issued new guidelines to reimburse a maximum amount of Rs.35 million for a telecommunication tower or 75% of the actual cost incurred for the construction of the said telecommunication tower and for related equipment, whichever is lower, to the service provider that constructed the tower, enabling the people of the relevant areas to receive the benefits of the project more quickly and effectively by accelerating the 'Gamata Sanniwedanaya' National Project. The Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, having apprised the Cabinet of Ministers in that regard, the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the same.

description: Amending the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-05-19 to introduce amendments to the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, incorporating the proposed tax reforms, in order to enhance the tax system while paving way for the revenue-based fiscal consolidation. Accordingly, the amending Bill has been prepared by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Financial Transactions Reporting (Amendment) Bill and the Prevention of Money Laundering (Amendment) Bill in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-01-26 to introduce further proposed amendments to the Financial Transactions Reporting (Amendment) Bill and the Prevention of Money Laundering (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in accordance with the Cabinet decision dated 2025-05-26. Accordingly, the final Bills have been prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Bills in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Cooperation between Sri Lanka and Japan on Economic Policy Dialogue
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka and Japan have maintained long-standing economic relations covering development cooperation, trade and investment. In addition to bilateral economic transactions, Sri Lanka and Japan have initiated discussions between the two countries to explore strategies to position Sri Lanka as a strategic export-oriented economic corridor, integrating Sri Lanka and Japan into the South Asian markets. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to enter into a Memorandum of Cooperation between Sri Lanka and Japan on Economic Policy Dialogue as part of the efforts to promote and strengthen trade, investment and economic development with a view to promoting comprehensive relations between Sri Lanka and Japan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of amendments to the Colombo Port City (Development Control) Regulations No.1 of 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Colombo Port City (Development Control) Regulations No. 1 of 2023 has been published on 2023-06-02 in terms of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No. 11 of 2021 to regulate the attributes of buildings and structures within the Port City. The said Regulations were previously amended by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2023-11-17. Measures have been taken to amend the said Regulations by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2025-12-29, based on the recommendations made by the Colombo Port City Economic Commission that the said Regulations should be further amended primarily, in respect of the adjustments to land areas including beach space, increasing the maximum height permitted for vertical development, and revision to the matrix classification. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said amended Order to Parliament for approval in terms of the provisions of section 71(4) of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply and delivery of Lubricating Oil for the Sapugaskanda Power Station for the period of 2026/2027
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 12 generating sets powered by diesel engines at the Sapugaskanda Power Plant operate as base load plants. The lubricants required for the said generating sets have to be procured and distributed in accordance with the categories specified in the list of lubricants recommended by the original equipment manufacturer as specified in the relevant operation and maintenance manual. The contract period of the current lubricant supplier is scheduled to expire on 2026-05-09. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to follow the national competitive bidding procedure to select a new supplier for a period of one year after the expiry of the aforesaid period, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the administrative building of the Echchallampaththu Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Echchallampaththu Police Station in Kantale, Trincomalee District is currently being operated with much difficulty in several small buildings, and as a result, the officers working at the Police Station as well as the public coming to obtain the services have been faced with severe inconvenience. In order to overcome this situation, it has been planned to construct a new administrative building for the Echchallampaththu Police Station, at an estimated cost of         Rs.75.94 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to implement the proposed project within the 2026-2028 Medium Term Budgetary Framework and to obtain the consultancy services of the project from the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of Intra Ocular Lenses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of 35 types of intra ocular lenses used to implant in the eye in the treatments for cataract or myopia. Five (05) bidders have submitted bids for the same. Based on the recommendations made after evaluating the said bids by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement for the purchase of 16 types of lenses out of the 35 types of lenses, to Jayasuriya Associates, Kandy and Elshaddai Enterprises (Pvt) Ltd., Colombo, the substantially responsive bidders for the relevant types of items, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Integrated Regional Development Programme proposed to be implemented in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Development Association of the World Bank Group is set to provide a financial allocation of USD 1,000 million to the country for a period of 6 years from 2026 to 2031, of which USD 100 million is planned to be used for the Integrated Regional Development Programme proposed to be implemented in the Northern and Eastern Provinces. Under the first phase of the programme, it is expected to implement projects that focus on enhancing regional production potential (tourism, fisheries, etc.) of the selected clusters in the Northern and Eastern Provinces, creating employment or improving existing employment opportunities, providing support to enterprises, attracting private capital, and improving infrastructure for institutional empowerment. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development for the Department of External Resources to conduct negotiations with the World Bank and for the Ministry to take other preliminary steps related to the implementation of the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of construction of the Renal Care Building to Accommodate the Proposed Professorial Units at the Teaching Hospital - Badulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Badulla General Hospital, which has been selected as the Clinical Training Centre of the Faculty of Medicine of the Uva Wellassa University, has been upgraded to a Teaching Hospital. The joint proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education; and the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the contract for the construction of the ten-storey Renal Care Building, the construction of which is currently suspended, to Central Engineering Services (Private) Limited, enabling to expeditiously complete its works,  with the aim of fulfilling approximately 80% of the professorial units and associated teaching facilities required for the clinical training activities of the said General Hospital, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Mineral Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 'National Mineral Policy' was first formulated in the year 1999 and was amended in the year 2023, covering matters such as creating an updated database on mineral resources, value addition to mineral exports, fostering mineral-related industrialists, sustainable management of mineral resources and the environment and resolving land ownership issues arising during mineral resource extraction. The National Mineral Policy so revised has been updated in line with the policy principles under the theme of ‘Sustainable Resource Utilization - Maximum Benefit Generation’ stated in the current Government's Policy Statement 'A Thriving Nation - A Beautiful Life'. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Entrepreneurship Development to implement the 'National Mineral Policy - 2026', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deployment of 10 new air-conditioned low-floor buses equipped with facilities for persons with facilities for persons with special needs, as a pilot project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been decided to implement an air-conditioned low-floor bus service equipped with facilities for persons with special needs, as a pilot project, using the provisions allocated under the 'Clean Sri Lanka' Project. Accordingly, the procurement for the purchase of 10 buses has been awarded by now, and those buses are scheduled to arrive in the country by 2026-03-15. It has been found that the Sri Lanka Transport Board does not have the capacity to provide the physical infrastructure and digital infrastructure required for the operation and maintenance of those buses. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to transfer the relevant 10 buses to Lanka Metro Transit (Private) Company established under the Sri Lanka Transport Board, as per the Cabinet decision taken on 2025-07-21, in order to implement the project for deploying 100 comfortable buses with enhanced and modern facilities for passenger transport in the Colombo urban area as an initial step towards the modernization of public transport and to operate those buses under the said Company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and the Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding was signed in 2012, between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and the National Defence Force of the Republic of Maldives for a period of 05 years and the Agreement was renewed in the year 2018. Based on the discussions held between the two parties after the expiry of the said MoU in 2023, it has been agreed to sign a new revised MoU with the objectives of organizing training programmes, implementing staff exchange programmes, organizing joint research and academic activities, exchanging academic publications and other information, and implementing cultural and athletic exchange programmes. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to sign the proposed MoU between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and the Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Maldives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of Subscriber SIM Cards (Subscriber Identification Modules - SIM) Regulations and the Regulations on Re-registration of Subscriber Information relating to SIM Cards obtained before 2nd August 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the provisions of the Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act, No.25 of 1991, the Subscriber SIM Cards (Subscriber Identification Modules - SIM) Regulations No.01 of 2019 had been published on 2019-08-02, and the said Regulations are applicable only to SIM Cards issued after the said date. Therefore, the telephone operator companies do not possess information about certain subscribers registered before 2019-08-02, and it has created a problematic situation in certain legal investigations. Further, the need to amend the existing Regulations to suit the current needs by incorporating new provisions related to the registration of subscribers between the ages of 16 and 17 and the issuance of SIM cards to foreigners visiting the country has also been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy to introduce new Regulations, making provisions for the re-registration of subscriber information relating to SIM Cards obtained prior to 2019-08-02 and amending the existing Subscriber SIM Cards (Subscriber Identification Modules - SIM) Regulations No.01 of 2019 as appropriate, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Trade and Investment Policies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Applications have been invited from qualified officers of the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service to identify a suitable officer for the vacant Post of Director General of the Department of Trade and Investment Policy of the General Treasury. Accordingly, the Board of Interview has recommended that Mrs. I.J. Abeyratne, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service who obtained the highest marks at the interview conducted, be appointed to the said Post. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to appoint Mrs. I.J. Abeyratne to the Post of Director General of the Department of Trade and Investment Policy with immediate effect, based on the said recommendation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding Term Contract for the procurement of 05 shipments of Gasoline 92 Unl during the period from 2026-03-15 to 2026-09-14
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited from the suppliers registered in the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation for the procurement of 05 shipments of 300,000 ± 5% Bbl of Gasoline 92 Unl during the period from 2026-03-15 to 2026-09-14 to the said Corporation. 06 suppliers have submitted bids for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the said contract to M/s. Epdesa Pte. Ltd., Singapore, the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee made after evaluation of the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an adjacent building for expanding the space of Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Office of the Chief Secretary, the Council Chamber, 05 Offices of the Deputy Chief Secretariats, and 05 Ministries in charge of subjects exercising development and administrative affairs are housed in the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Complex which has been constructed in the year 2023. In addition, departments, statutory institutions and 36 divisions established under each Ministry in charge of subjects are located in the said Complex and more than a staff of 950 is engaged in the duty in the said Complex. At present, due to the insufficient space in the said complex, owing to the significant increase in the number of employees and various divisions of the Institutions, services have to be maintained amidst various difficulties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to construct a new three-storey building adjacent to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Complex, using funds of the Provincial Council, at a total cost estimate of Rs. 196.8 million, enabling to secure adequate space facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing aesthetic instruments for the promotion of school aesthetic education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although the teaching of art subjects such as music, dancing, visual arts and drama under aesthetic education continues in the school system in Sri Lanka, it has been observed that there is a severe shortage of instruments required for this purpose in many schools. Also, there is a situation where modern instruments that meet the needs of children are not available in the school system, and it has been reported that many of the existing instruments are outdated and unusable. It has been observed that this situation has a serious impact on the quality of aesthetic education and the overall personality development of children. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to implement a project to provide aesthetic instruments to promote school aesthetic education during the period from 2026 to 2028 at an estimated cost of Rs.1,215 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining technical assistance of the Mahaweli Consultancy Bureau for the implementation of Rural Community Water Supply Schemes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of National Community Water Supply, which was established in 2014 with the main objective of ensuring the sustainability of various community water supply schemes implemented in Sri Lanka, has initiated 367 new community water projects under the 'Praja Jala Abhimani' programme in 2019/2020 and 2021. Out of these, 175 projects that could not be completed due to the COVID-19 pandemic and the economic crisis, need to be further implemented and completed. However, it has been identified that the current technical staff of the Department of National Community Water Supply is insufficient to implement those projects. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to obtain technical services such as feasibility studies/investigations, preparation of preliminary and detailed engineering designs, preparation of procurement documents and project supervision from the Mahaweli Consultancy Bureau during the period of 2026 - 2027, so that the work of 48 projects out of those 175 projects that need to be completed without delay can be completed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renewable Energy Resource Development Plan 2025‑2030
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the National Policy on Renewable Energy, it is essential to prepare a Renewable Energy Resource Development Plan to meet 70% of the national electricity demand from renewable energy sources by 2030 and to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050. The Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority Act No.35 of 2007 also has mandated the preparation of the said Plan. Accordingly, the 'Renewable Energy Resources Development Plan 2025 - 2030', which has been prepared by the Sustainable Energy Authority of  Sri Lanka in consultation with all relevant parties, covering three (03) key areas, namely identification of the suitable lands and prioritization, renewable energy resource maps and renewable energy park development timeline and also including floating solar power projects, having submitted to the Cabinet by the Minister of Energy, approval of the Cabinet was granted for the same.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on the Establishment of a Political Consultations Mechanism between Sri Lanka and Finland
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka and Finland have initiated official diplomatic relations in 1954, and this year marks the 72nd anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two parties. The relationship between the two countries, strengthened by political, economic, socio-cultural, educational, environmental and people to people exchanges during that period, has evolved into a dynamic partnership. It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties with the aim of promoting and strengthening relations in the sectors of political, economic, educational, environmental, consular and cultural, as well as exchanging views on regional and multilateral matters of mutual interest, as of now. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Finland on the Establishment of a Political Consultations Mechanism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Orders made under the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962 and the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the following Orders made under the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962 and the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notifications, to Parliament for approval -

The Revenue Protection Order No.05/2025 made under the provisions of the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962 published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2464/15 dated 2025-11-25 to amend the Customs Import Duty of 20%, which had been declared on the hybrid Mandarin variety, to 20% or Rs.60 per kg.


The Order imposed under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 and published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2464/14 dated 2025-11-25, enabling to continue the existing Special Commodity Levy for the importation of potatoes and big onions and to lift the Special Commodity Levy existed for hybrid mandarin variety.


The Order imposed under the provisions of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2464/16 dated 2025-12-04, for not charging the Special Commodity Levy for the donations received under the Disaster Recovery Project to facilitate people affected by the cyclone Ditwah.


The Order imposed under the provisions of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2469/12 dated 2025-12-31, to continue to maintain the tax rates applicable on 62 commodities under the Special Commodity Levy Act No.48 of 2007, which had been in effect until 2025-12-31 at the same rates up to 2026-12-31, and to grant duty concessions on dates to be received as donations for the Ramadan festive season.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Technical Education and Training
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The post of Director General of the Department of Technical Education and Training is currently vacant. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to appoint Mrs. Dilky Wathsala Marambage, Grade I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as the Director (Administration) of the Department of Agriculture, to act in the said post on full-time basis.

description: Introduction of new Laws pertaining to the subject of Women and Child Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- It is planned to introduce several new laws and amend several existing laws in the year 2026 related to the scope of the Ministry of Women and Child Affairs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to introduce new laws and amend existing laws as follows, was approved by the Cabinet:

Introducing a new law addressing cybercrime against children


Introducing a new Act as the 'Child Rights Act' in compliance with the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child.


Repealing the existing Prevention of Domestic Violence Act, No.34 of 2005 and introducing a new Act for the same.


Formulation of a new law for foster care.


Amendment of the Children's Act (Children and Young Persons Ordinance No.48 of 1939).


Amendment of the Adoption of Children Ordinance No.24 of 1941.


Amendment to the National Child Protection Authority Act, No.50 of 1988.

description: Submission of the Motor Traffic (Temporary Extension of the period of validity of Driving Licences) Regulations, No.04 of 2025, for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the severe weather conditions that affected the island in November 2025, which caused serious damage to normal life, the public had to face difficulties in renewing their driving licenses by appearing on the due dates. Also, due to technical errors in the computer system of the Department of Motor Traffic related to the issuance of driving licenses during that period, it was not possible to continue the services of issuing and renewing driving licenses. Therefore, in order to avoid any adverse impact on road safety and road users, the Motor Traffic (Temporary Extension of the period of validity of Driving Licenses) Regulations, No.04 of 2025 has been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2467/52 dated 17 December 2025, by extending the validity period of driving licenses that were due to expire between 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-24 by one month from the date on which they were due to expire. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to submit the said Regulations in terms of Motor Traffic Act (Chapter 203), to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Restoration plan of the Kalido Coastal Stretch, Lagoon and Kalu Ganga Estuary at Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The sand bar at the Kalido beach near the Kalu Ganga estuary has been completely eroded and the adjacent coastal belt in extent of 2.5 km has been completely eroded due to the cut off of the said sand barrier at the place where it directly faces the Kalu Ganga to enable free flow of water, in order to control the severe flood situation that occurred in 2017, and the Kalu Ganga estuary has not yet restored to its natural stable position. Under the said backdrop, rapid coastal erosion is taking place on the coastal strip of Kalutara North, which has severely affected the tourism industry and infrastructure. Also, the Kalutara Lagoon has experienced problems with fisheries and environmental problems due to the lack of water flow, pollution and sedimentation. Therefore, as a long-term solution to these problems, the Department of Coast Conservation and Coastal Resources Management having conducted a formal study has planned a project, in consultation with relevant parties to open a portion of the filled sand bar at the southern direction to the Kalu Ganga Estuary thereby diverting the river to the southern direction as it was before.  The proposal made by the Minister of Environment to implement the said project through the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Value Addition Project for Rock Phosphate mined by Lanka Phosphate Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-08-04 to call for expressions of interest from suitable investors to implement a value addition project for rock phosphate mined by Lanka Phosphate Limited under public-private partnership. As per the said Cabinet decision, expressions of interest have been invited, and 14 expressions of interest have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to invite project proposals for the implementation of the proposed project from qualified investors selected after evaluating the said expressions of interest, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Avarankal - Thondamanaru Road (B-033) Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure for the rehabilitation of the 6.03 km long Avarankal - Thondamanaru (B-033) road aiming to enhance the mobility to socio-economic centers and other key amenities, meeting the growing transportation needs of the area, and providing a solution for the traffic congestion. Eight (08) bids have been received for the same. After evaluating the bids, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the said contract to M/s Nem Construction (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder, based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee.

description: Calling for Investment Proposals for the disposal of a plot of land located adjacent to the Gregory Lake on the Dun Shortcut Road, Nuwara Eliya, to implement a Tourist-Attraction Theme Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet Appointed Special Committee to recommend the most suitable development activities for lands owned by the Urban Development Authority that have not yet been used for development activities has recommend that the land in extent of 10 acres, 03 roods and 28.04 perches located adjacent to the Gregory Lake on the Dun Shortcut Road, Nuwara Eliya, belonging to the Urban Development Authority, is suitable for the implementation of a project of a Theme Park that will attract tourists. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to call for investment proposals following the international competitive procurement method so that the said land can be disposed to a suitable investor for a period of 50 years for the implementation of the proposed project.

description: Procurement of an Automated Spectrum Management System for the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka has been using the SPECTRAplus Spectrum Management System as the primary tool for National Spectrum Management Operations since 2001. However, it has been recognized that the said system, which has been in existence for more than two decades, is not sufficient to meet the current technological, regulatory and operational challenges as well as the requirements of the Sri Lanka's developing telecommunications and data communications sector. Therefore, the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka has decided to procure an ultra modern automated spectrum management system that will strengthen the national spectrum administration, enhance operational efficiency, ensure regulatory compliance, and facilitate integration with modern monitoring systems and digital services provided to the public. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, to pursue action to purchase a modern automatic spectrum management system to the said Commission, following the international competitive procurement procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval and implementation mechanism of the projects within the year 2026 under the 'Prajashakthi' National Movement to Eradicate Poverty
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has decided to implement the 'Prajashakti' National Movement to Eradicate Poverty starting from the year 2026 to achieve the target of reducing multidimensional poverty in 05 units by 2030 compared to the year 2025. Accordingly, it has been planned to implement the project proposals received through Community Development Councils under the 06 main areas of Social Environment, Food Security, Human Resource Development, Protection, Production Economy and Supply Chain and Access, with the recommendations of the Regional Coordinating Committees and District Coordinating Committees. A provision of Rs.25 billion has been allocated through the budget for the year 2026 for the implementation of the projects so identified. Out of this, Rs.23 billion is expected to be utilized for the implementation of projects at the district level, and the remaining Rs.02 billion is expected to be used for medium-scale projects at the national level and for training and research activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment to follow the guidelines jointly prepared by the Ministry of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment and the Department of National Planning so that the process of approving the identified projects can be carried out efficiently, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing Funds from the Export-Import Bank of Korea to carry out a Feasibility Study with regard to the relocation of Matara General Hospital in Kamburugamuwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet was granted on 2019-04-09 to implement the 'Medical Equipment Sector Development Loan Project' under the concessional funding window of the Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF) of the Export-Import Bank of Korea, with the aim of improving diagnostic and treatment capabilities through the purchase of essential medical equipment for selected healthcare institutions across the country. Nevertheless, taking into account the practical issues that have arisen in the implementation of the said Project, an agreement has been reached between the two parties during the EDCF Review Mission held in Colombo on 26th and 27th June, 2025 on the appropriateness of discontinuing the said Project and the need to implement projects with impactful alternatives aligned with the current national health needs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to formally cancel the previously approved 'Medical Equipment Sector Development Loan Project' and to take action to secure the necessary funds from the Export-Import Bank of Korea to conduct a feasibility study for the relocation of the Matara General Hospital in the Kamburugamuwa area in accordance with the Greater Matara Town Development Plan as per the agreement reached, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing an Implementation Agreement pertaining to the Grant provided by the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development to prepare the proposed 'Sri Lanka Ports and Logistics Development Project'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-10-27, has given approval to sign the Grant Agreement to obtain a Grant of US$ 03 million from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development for the preparation of the 'Sri Lanka Ports and Logistics Development Project'. Accordingly, the said Grant Agreement was signed by the Secretary to the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development on 2025-10-31. In accordance with the provisions of the said Grant Agreement, an Implementation Agreement has to be entered into between the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the Sri Lanka Ports Authority. Further, a Project Management Unit should also be established to provide support and monitor the operational, technical, social, environmental, procurement and financial management activities of the said project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to sign the proposed Implementation Agreement between the two parties and subsequently establish a Project Management Unit, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for Investment Proposals for the disposal of a plot of land at Baladaksha Mawatha, Colombo 03 belonging to the Urban Development Authority on 99 year lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to dispose a plot of land in extent of 0.42 hectares, situated at Baladaksha Mawatha, Colombo 03, which has been transferred to the Urban Development Authority as a Free Grant under section 6(1) of the State Land Ordinance, for suitable development purposes. Since the relevant land is located within the mixed development zone as per the Beira Lake Intervention Area Development Guide Plan, the Special Committee appointed by the Cabinet to recommend the lands owned by the Urban Development Authority which have not been utilized up to now for the most suitable development activities, has recommended to utilize the said land to implement a mixed development project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to invite investment proposals under the International Competitive Bidding procedure in accordance with the Government Procurement Guidelines for the disposal of the said land to a suitable investor on long-term lease basis for a period of 99 years for the implementation of a high-rise mixed development project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of 09 plots of lands located on either side of Diyawanna Oya adjacent to the Waters Edge Hotel, Battaramulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation has planned and implemented the Colombo Metropolitan Flood Prevention Development Project, which includes the wetland zone around the Diyawanna Oya in Battaramulla. Under the said project, drainage development works have been completed in the area around Waters Edge Hotel in Battaramulla. Accordingly, the Urban Development Authority has planned to implement the 'Frolic Island Recreational Hub' project using the lands located on either side of Diyawanna Oya for public entertainment and it has been published in the year 2024 under the Kaduwela Urban Development Plan. 09 plots of land with a total area of ​​13.57 acres have been identified for the implementation of the proposed project, and the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to invite investment proposals in accordance with the Government Procurement Guidelines and following the International Competitive Bidding procedure, to dispose the said plots of land to suitable investors on lease basis for the implementation of projects including entertainment activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of Circulars issued in terms of the provisions of the State Lands Ordinance and the Land Development Ordinance in accordance with present day needs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The provisions of the State Land Ordinance promulgated in 1947 are followed for the disposal of State lands on long-term lease basis and the provisions of the Land Development Ordinance promulgated in 1935 are followed for the disposal of middle class lands, issuance of deeds of grants and land alienation. The said Ordinances have been amended from time to time while maintaining their existing legal aspects, and Circulars have also been issued in that regard. However, it has been identified that the procedures adopted in disposing State lands on long-term lease basis and in issuing deeds of grants for lands and alienating lands, the methods used for calculating the lease and valuation fees levied should be updated to suit the present day needs. Further, it is essential to remove unnecessary delays and obstacles caused by circulars in attracting local and foreign investments and to create more convenient and simplified procedures to encourage investors. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to appoint a Committee of Experts under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to obtain recommendations for amending the Circulars issued by the Commissioner General of Lands under the provisions of the said Ordinances to suit the present needs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing farms operating under the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka to farmers for cultivation on lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2022-12-05, granted approval to involve private investors in the management of 17 farms belonging to the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka, where seed paddy production, supplementary crop seed production and livestock production activities are carried out, on a long-term lease basis or under the Public-Private Partnership Method, with the aim of increasing the productivity of such farms. However, under the current Government policy, it has been planned to get the farmers in the Mahaweli regions involved in the development activities of such farms while retaining the land ownership with the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka, with the objectives of continuously sustaining the development activities of those farms, transforming farms into profitable economic units, fulfilling the national seed paddy requirement, providing a high contribution to national production, encouraging regional youth agricultural entrepreneurs towards agriculture and uplifting the living standards of settlers, Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to take the following actions,  was approved by the Cabinet:

To auction irrigated lands of Mahaweli farms for seed paddy production to Mahaweli regional agricultural entrepreneurs under a seasonal lease basis and allocate through agreement.


To auction developed/undeveloped but cultivable/ underdeveloped upland lands of Mahaweli farms for supplementary crop/ supplementary crop seed production to the regional farming community under a seasonal lease basis and allocate through agreement.


To provide livestock units of Mahaweli farms that are not properly maintained and have not generated profits for a period of 03 years or more to regional entrepreneurs/farmers under a formal short-term lease system for a maximum period of 03 years.


to subdivide lands with under developed perennial crops and lands with perennial crops that do not deliver potential harvest/ income for five (05) years or more into suitable plots based on accurate measurements, determine the value of each land plot according to land value, potential crop yield and maximum obtainable income and provide such lands to the Mahaweli regional farming community solely for cultivation under a short term formal lease system.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Romania on Cooperation in the Field of Labour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Romania, which maintains long-standing and cordial diplomatic relations with Sri Lanka in various fields for decades, has become an emerging destination for skilled and semi-skilled Sri Lankan workers, especially in sectors such as construction, manufacturing, hospitality and services. Currently, the recruitment of Sri Lankan workers to Romania is carried out by licensed private employment agencies under the supervision of the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment. However, since both sides have recognized the appropriateness of establishing a more organized and sustainable recruitment pathway in view of the increasing demand for workers, the Cabinet granted its approval for the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of Romania on Cooperation in the field of Labour with the following objectives:

Establishing a formal mechanism for labour recruitment and management.


Promoting ethical and transparent recruitment practices.


Safeguarding the rights and welfare of migrant workers.


Facilitating regular consultations between the competent authorities of both countries.


Enhancing technical cooperation, skills recognition and capacity building in the labour sector.

description: Issuance of new Circular instructions for Implementation Modality and Human Resource Utilization for Development Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In order to achieve the development objectives of Sri Lanka, it is essential to implement development projects without unnecessary delay. Further, with a view to achieving the desired outcomes of those projects within the expected timeframe, human and physical resources should be allocated to the projects in a wellstructured and coordinated manner and such resources should be managed efficiently and effectively. Therefore, it has been identified that the current Circular provisions should be updated to achieve the main objectives of ensuring the effective implementation of Government projects, materializing optimal returns on Governments capital expenditure, and ensuring that the expected benefits from development programmes and projects implemented on public investment are received by the public in a timely manner. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to revoke the Management Services Circular No.01/2019 dated 2019-03-15, which was issued in relation to the implementation of development projects, and to issue a new Management Services Circular containing updated provisions in its place, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Report on the Deviation of Headline Inflation from Inflation Target set out in the Monetary Policy Framework Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Monetary Policy Framework Agreement signed between the Minister of Finance and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka on 2023-10-03 under section 26(1) of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, No.16 of 2023, the Central Bank of Sri Lanka is vested with the responsibility of maintaining quarterly headline inflation at a level of 5% as measured by the Colombo Consumer Price Index compiled by the Department of Census and Statistics. In accordance with the section 26(5) of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, No.16 of 2023, if the Central Bank of Sri Lanka fails to meet the inflation target by a specified margin for two consecutive quarters, the Monetary Policy Board of the Central Bank shall submit a Report to Parliament through the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance. The report shall also be made available to the general public as well. The quarterly average of headline inflation based on the Colombo Consumer Price Index in the second and third quarters of 2025 was (-1.1)% and 0.8% respectively, which has remained more than 2 percentage points below the inflation target for two consecutive quarters. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit to Parliament the Report on the Deviation of Headline Inflation, submitted to the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance under section 26(5) of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. W.A. Dharmasiri, who is currently serving as the District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Galle, is due to retire from the public service after 2026-01-25. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint Mr. K.U.
