Chandralal,  Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as the Secretary to the Southern Provincial Ministry of Sports & Youth Affairs, Rural Development, Cultural & Arts Affairs, Social Welfare, Probation & Child Care Services, Women's Affairs & Home Economic Promotion, Housing & Construction, and Manpower and Security, to the vacant post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Galle, with effect from 2026-01-26.

description: Revision of the Provision relating to the pension entitlement in the appointment letters of the Public Officers recruited after 2016-01-01
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per a 2016 Budget proposal relating to the introduction of a more suitable contributory pension scheme for Public Officers, a provision has been included in the appointment letters of all Officers recruited into the public service from 2016-01-01 stating, 'This appointment is pensionable. You shall be subjected to the policy decision taken by the government in due course regarding the pension scheme you are entitled.' However, a new pension scheme has not yet been implemented for those appointed to the public service after 2016-01-01, and it has been proposed in the Budget 2026 to amend the condition relating to the pension stated in the relevant appointment letters, confirming their entitlement to the existing pension scheme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to amend the provision relating to the pension stated in the relevant appointment letters of all Public Officers recruited into the public service after 2016-01-01 to read as 'This appointment is pensionable. Furthermore, you shall contribute to the Widows' and Orphans' Pension Scheme/Widowers' and Orphans' Pension Scheme. Contributions shall be made as required by the Government from time to time.' and to issue Circular instructions relating to the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Insurance Institute Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Insurance Institute was established in 1982 to act as the central organization for the promotion and development of education in the insurance sector and is the only professional institution in Sri Lanka that conducts educational programmes, training sessions and professional examinations in insurance. Passing the examinations conducted by the Sri Lanka Insurance Institute on behalf of the Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka is essential to qualify as a licensed insurance agent under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No.43 of 2000. The then Ministry in charge of the subject of Finance has drafted a preliminary Bill in the years 2018 and 2019 to incorporate the Sri Lanka Insurance Institute in order to provide the said Institute with the necessary powers to carry out its functions in a proper manner and to enable it to operate as a financially sustainable institution. The concurrence of the present Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka has been received for the said preliminary Bill. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the Sri Lanka Insurance Institute Bill, based on the said preliminary Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procedure for providing 2026 budget relief for uplifting the living standards of plantation workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - With the aim of providing a fair daily wage to the plantation workers to be commensurate with their service, the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, proposed in the 2026 Budget speech to increase the minimum daily wage of plantation workers to Rs.1,550/- and to pay them a daily attendance incentive of Rs.200/-. Accordingly, a provision of Rs.5,000 million has been allocated through the Budget in the year 2026 to implement the said proposal. Accordingly, the Ministry of Plantation and Community Infrastructure, in consultation with all relevant parties, has planned to pay the incentive proposed by the government for a period of 06 months with effect from 01st January 2026 through the relevant plantation companies and thereafter to directly credit the said incentive to the personal bank accounts of the plantation workers. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Labour and the Minister of Plantation and Community Infrastructure to pay the relevant incentive allowance to plantation workers following the said methodology, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Project for the Construction of 300 Housing Units at Arunodaya Mawatha, Obeysekarapura, Rajagiriya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2020-03-04 to implement the project for the construction of 300 Housing Units at Arunodaya Mawatha, Obeysekarapura, Rajagiriya, one of the 06 sub-projects of the Project for the construction of 4,074 Housing Units under a loan assistance of US$ 200 million from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. Due to the poor performance of the contractor of the said project, the relevant Contract Agreement has been cancelled and bids have been invited under the National Competitive Bidding Procedure to select a suitable contractor to re-commence the said project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the contract for the implementation of the Project to construct 300 Housing Units at Arunodaya Mawatha, Obeysekarapura, Rajagiriya, to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd., based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee pertaining to the 06 bids submitted, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Baseline Road Extension Project Phase III
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2009-11-11, granted approval to construct a sixlane carriageway from Kirulapone Junction to Dutugemunu Street on the Colombo-Horana Road for a distance of a length of 0.86 km as the Phase III of the Baseline Road Extension Project. However, due to the economic crisis that occurred  in 2022, the construction of the project has been temporarily suspended based on the recommendation of the Officials’ Committee for ReStrategizing and Acceleration of Mega-Scale Development Projects. The said project has been identified as a priority infrastructure development project under the National Road Master Plan of the country, and about 90% of the land acquisition activities required for the relevant construction activities have been completed by now. The implementation of the project is expected to significantly reduce travel time and traffic congestion on the Colombo-Horana road, thereby increasing urban mobility and economic productivity. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to resume the construction activities of Phase III of the Baseline Road Extension Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resuming the Kivul Oya Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2011-09-28, granted approval to implement the Kivul Oya Reservoir Development Project with the aim of addressing the major issues such as water shortage, poverty and low potential in agricultural production, and developing the regional economy in the Vavuniya and Mullaitivu Districts by efficient and effective utilization of the water resources of the Kivul Oya. Although the said project, which was an estimated cost of Rs.4,170 million by then, had been planned to be implemented within a period of 04 years within the 'L' Zone of the Mahaweli Reservoir Development System, due to the economic downturn that occurred in the country in 2022, it was later decided to temporarily suspend the project from 2023-12-31. Taking into consideration the need to implement the proposed project expeditiously as a remedy to the water shortage for drinking and other needs in the project area, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to resume the Kivul Oya Development Project which has been temporarily suspended at present, to complete the said project during the period from 2026 to the end of 2031 using local funds, and to revise the total cost estimate of the project to 23,456 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Adopting guidelines introduced by the Universal Postal Union to implement postal monitoring operations for the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the fact that the United States of America has decided, to remove the tariff-free minimum releases for goods to the value of US$ 800 or less than that existed up to then, with effect from 2025-08-29, with the exception of non-commercial mere gifts and documents to the value of US$100 or less than that and postal items related to special exceptions, all other international postal items containing goods which are sent to the United States of America became subject to customs duties irrespective of their value. Further, the postal administration of the United States of America will not be responsible for any international postal items sent to the United States without paying the applicable duties. This has severely affected the Sri Lankan businessmen who send goods to the United States by mail through e-commerce platforms. As a remedy to this situation, the Universal Postal Union has introduced a special software application, which provides the facility to remit the duties and other charges levied on the relevant postal items when they arrive in the United States of America through the Customs Border Protection licensed ZONOS Institute of the United States of America. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to follow the guidelines issued by the Universal Postal Union in relation to that process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into the Memorandum of Understanding to establish the Indian Ocean Coastal States Alliance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Tuna fishery sector contributes significantly to national economies, food security, employment generation and the socio-economic stability of coastal communities in the Indian Ocean region. However, overfishing poses a risk of declining fish stocks and food security concerns. Therefore, it has been proposed to establish the Indian Ocean Coastal States Alliance through a Memorandum of Understanding among Bangladesh, Indonesia, Iran, Madagascar, Malaysia, Maldives, Mozambique, Pakistan, Somalia, South Africa and Sri Lanka to strengthen cooperation in the management of tuna fishery resources. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to sign the Memorandum of Understanding to establish the Indian Ocean Coastal States Alliance, with the aim of enhancing cooperation among member States, improving livelihoods of fishing communities, building capacity and sustainably managing fishery resources, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Financial Transactions Reporting (Amendment) Bill, the Prevention of Money Laundering (Amendment) Bill and the Convention on the Suppression of Terrorist Financing (Amendment) Bill, to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025 05 26 to amend the Financial Transactions Reporting Act No.6 of 2006, the Prevention of Money Laundering Act No.5 of 2006 and the Convention on the Suppression of Terrorist Financing Act No.25 of 2005. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the relevant amendment Bills prepared by the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minster Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Bills in the Government Gazette and to submit the same thereafter, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a Digital Card System for the supply of fuel to Vehicles belonging to Government Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The necessity to use a digital card system for supplying fuel to vehicles belonging to Government institutions has been identified. This will enable to top up through the online banking system according to the fuel requirement, and procure fuel with high transparency and efficiency by minimizing personnel intervention. The Bank of Ceylon and the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation have jointly introduced the system for supplying fuel to vehicles through digital cards by now. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to implement the said system for supplying fuel to pool vehicles of the Presidential Secretariat as a pilot project, in the first instance and based on its success, to implement the same system for other Government institutions as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the Festival Advance granted to the Public Officers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per the provisions of the Establishments Code regarding the payment of festival advance to the Public Officers, an officer can claim an advance of Rs.10,000/- for festive occasions such as Thai Pongal, Ramadan, Sinhala and Hindu New Year, Vesak, Deepavali and Christmas and for pilgrimages (such as Sri Pada pilgrimage and Hajj pilgrimage). Provisions have been made to recover the said advance amount in 08 monthly installments without interest or earlier if necessary. It has been proposed to increase the said festival advance amount to Rs. 15,000/- in the budget 2026. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to revise the relevant provisions of the Establishments Code enabling to increase the festival advance amount given to the Public Officers to Rs.15,000/- and to issue circular instructions regarding the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Settlement of outstanding payments in respect of medical supplies procured from the State Pharmaceuticals Corporation for the period of 2008 - 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Medical Supplies Division purchases medicines and other medical supplies required by hospitals and health institutions across the island from the State Pharmaceuticals Corporation, the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation and local manufacturers and thereafter stores and distribute them. Although payments have been made up to 2023 12 31 from the provisions annually allocated by the General Treasury to the Ministry of Health and Mass Media for such payments, the State Pharmaceuticals Corporation has informed the Ministry of Health and Mass Media on several occasions that there is an outstanding amount of Rs.32.92 billion to be further settled to the Corporation for the period from 2008 to 2023. This matter has arisen at a 2026 budget discussion chaired by the Hon. President and upon the instructions given at the said discussion; matters have been examined, headed by the Department of Public Enterprises, on the payments to be settled. Accordingly, it has been confirmed that Rs.23.87 billion is to be paid from 2018 01 01 to 2023 12 31. Similarly, the amount to be settled from 2008 01 01 to 2017 12 31 is being calculated. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media, the Cabinet has approved the payment of Rs.23.87 billion for the period from 2018 01 01 to 2023 12 31 in a phased out manner, during this year.

description: Launching currency exchange counters at the Arrival Terminal of the Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Currency exchange counters have been operated within the customs area of the Bandaranaike International Airport to facilitate the requirements of foreign currency exchange of incoming passengers. The need to relocate the Currency exchange counters operated at the Arrival Terminal has emerged, in the rearrangement of the said terminal as a part of the airport development initiative. Upon the failure to reach an agreement relating to the monthly rental applicable in the location of Currency exchange counters at the newly allocated locations, Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited has taken steps to suspend the existed Contract Agreements. Subsequently, steps have been taken to invite bids from institutions approved/authorized by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the establishment of foreign currency exchange counters for a contract period of 03 years in a newly allocated area at the arrival terminal under the limited competitive bidding method. Accordingly, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee in respect of five (05) bids received, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award contracts for the operation of foreign currency exchange counters for a period of 03 years as follows:

description: Disposal of scrap metals available in the Department of Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under the National Competitive Bidding Procedure for the disposal of scrap metal in the Department of Sri Lanka Railways. Eleven (11) bidders have submitted bids for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-12-10 for the disposal of scrap metal related to several items. Accordingly, taking into account the recommendations made by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, based on the quotations agreed upon the negotiations conducted with M/s S.R. Steel (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive highest bidder in respect of 04 more scrap metal items, the proposal submitted by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to dispose scrap metal items to M/s S.R. Steel (Pvt) Ltd, for a sum of Rs.114.51 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Selection of suitable firms to obtain consultancy services for the reconstruction of civil, railway and service infrastructure affected by the cyclone 'Ditwah'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Transport, Highways and Urban Development, together with the Road Development Authority and the Sri Lanka Railways, is engaged in an expeditious process of rehabilitating the roads and rail road infrastructure damaged by the Cyclone 'Ditwah' on medium and long-term basis. It has been observed that the relevant rehabilitation works are getting delayed due to the insufficient professional staff currently employed by the Road Development Authority and the Sri Lanka Railways for the preparation of plans and estimates, construction supervision, etc. As a remedy, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to register qualified consultancy firms for a period of 02 years following the formal procurement procedure and to call for quotations on a competitive basis from among the registered consultancy firms and obtain services for each task based on the service requirement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the programme of providing an allowance to school students to purchase stationeries in the year 2026, as well
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Measures have been taken in the year 2025 to provide an allowance of Rs.6,000/- per child from the families receiving Aswesuma benefits through the Welfare Benefits Board for the purchase of school stationery and to pay an allowance of Rs.6,000/- per beneficiary through the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to students studying in schools with less than 300 students across the island who are not included in the Aswesuma programme but are eligible for the allowance, lay and clergy students and Seelamathas in Pirivena, and school students in Child Development Centers. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to implement the said programme in the year 2026 as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the Water Safety Conference and Exhibition 2026 of the International Water Conference
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Water Supply and Drainage Board has agreed to host the Water Safety Conference and Exhibition 2026 of the International Water Conference in Sri Lanka to coincide with the Annual Symposium under the theme of 'Water and Sustainable Development' of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board. The said conference and the exhibition will be attended by the leading global experts from academia, industry, government regulatory bodies and international organizations involved in the water sector. This will provide an opportunity to foster dialogue and collaboration among stakeholders committed to providing safe and sustainable drinking water, thereby promoting a meaningful international partnership. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to host the Water Safety Conference and Exhibition 2026 of the International Water Conference at the Centre of Excellence for Water and Sanitation of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board in Ratmalana from 23rd to 25th March 2026, coinciding with World Water Day.

description: Preparation of Engineering Estimates for Buildings of Government Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that using a Common Building Schedule of Rates as a basis in preparing engineering estimates for buildings of Government Institutions can maintain uniformity in the total cost estimates, and it has been recommended at the meeting of the Committee on Public Accounts held on 2024 07 23 that it would be appropriate to give legal validity to the 'Building Schedule of Rates' of the Department of Buildings so that it can be used as the basis for that purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to issue necessary Circular instructions to use the 'Building Schedule of Rates' prepared by the Department of Buildings as the basis in preparing engineering estimates for buildings by all Institutions belonging to the Central Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Sri Lanka Electricity Industry Preliminary Transfer Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Power Sector Reforms Secretariat has prepared the Preliminary Transfer Plan in accordance with the policy directions of the Minister in charge of the subject of Power in terms of the provisions of the Sri Lanka Electricity (Amendment) Act, No.36 of 2024. The Preliminary Transfer Plan contains all the information relevant to the transfer of the activities related to the restructuring of generation, transmission, distribution and supply of electricity and the financial plan for the transfer of assets and liabilities to the successor companies to commence operations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy for the Preliminary Transfer Plan and for the transfer of the assets, liabilities, duties, functions and activities of the Ceylon Electricity Board by the Ceylon Electricity Board to the successor companies in accordance with the Preliminary Transfer Plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Project for Protocol Based Management of Hypertension and Diabetes at Primary Care Level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2021 01 11, granted approval for the implementation of the 'A multi-intervention strategy to improve Hypertension prevention and management within Sri Lanka’s integrated primary health care service delivery model' project, utilizing a Grant of US$ 304,795 provided by the Resolve to Save Lives to the then Ministry of Health. Accordingly, the activities of the said project have been implemented in the Districts of Kalutara, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Matale during the period from 2021 to 2024. Taking into account the positive outcomes of the relevant project, it has been planned to implement the said project in Galle, Colombo and Gampaha Districts as well. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said project in Galle, Colombo and Gampaha Districts as well under a total financial Grant of US$ 242,125 provided by the Resolve to Save Lives, together with the remaining funds in the initial stages of the said project and additional financial grants, under the name of 'Protocol Based Management of Hypertension and Diabetes at Primary Care Level', and to enter into an Agreement with Resolve to Save Lives to provide financial provisions for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of India for the implementation of the project for the construction of the four storied medical ward complex at the District General Hospital, Mullaitivu
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The District General Hospital, Mullaitivu is the main healthcare institution catering to the population of Mullaitivu District and its surrounding areas. The said hospital consists of 8 specialist units providing inward care services and has the total bed capacity of 195. A four-storied Medical Ward Complex has been planned to be constructed at the District General Hospital, Mullaitivu under the steps taken to upgrade the major hospitals operating as tertiary care institutions to provide high quality continuous care services at low patient costs. The Government of India has agreed to provide a Financial Grant of 600 million Sri Lankan Rupees for this purpose. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the relevant project using the said Financial Grant and to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of India for this purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing underutilized lands/properties to suitable investors for optimal utilization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Actions are being taken to dispose the underutilized lands/properties identified under the first phase of the underutilized lands/properties available under the Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation, the Janatha Estates Development Board and Elkaduwa Plantations Limited, which are under the purview of the Ministry of Plantation and Community Infrastructure, to suitable investors as per the approval granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025 06 02. It has been observed that the underutilized lands/properties that were not included in the first phase continue to exist under the relevant institutions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation and Community Infrastructure to provide the following lands/properties to suitable investors on lease basis for optimal utilization, following the due procurement methodology, was approved by the Cabinet.

* 	Underutilized lands/properties owned by the Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation, the Janatha Estate Development Board and the Elkaduwa Plantation Limited, identified under the second phase.

* 	The Mawarala Estate in extent of 40.48 hectares and the Tea Factory situated in the Matara District belonging to the Tea Shakthi Fund.

* 	The 1,541 hectares of underutilized land in the Kondachchi Estate owned by the Sri Lanka Cashew Corporation.

description: Implementation of the National Policy on Fisheries and Aquaculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The drafting of the National Policy on Fisheries and Aquaculture has been initiated with the aim of equitably distributing the benefits of the fishery industry and sustainably managing fisheries and aquaculture. It has been updated from time to time in accordance with timely needs. However, no steps have been taken so far to obtain the approval of the Cabinet for the same. In accordance with the current Government's policy statement 'A Thriving Nation - A Beautiful Life' the National Policy on Fisheries and Aquaculture has been updated and re drafted to align with the economic and development objectives of the Government and the recommendation of the Department of National Planning has been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to integrate the National Policy on Fisheries and Aquaculture with other relevant policies and implement the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of selected locations within the premises of the Pelwatte Sugar Factory of Lanka Sugar Company (Private) Limited under the Public Private Partnership methodology as places with tourist attractions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that there is a potential for developing selected locations on the premises of the Pelwatte Sugar Factory owned by Lanka Sugar Company (Private) Limited as places with tourist attractions. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to invite Expressions of Interest by following the due procurement guidelines to identify suitable investors for the development of selected locations under the Public-Private Partnership methodology and to invite project proposals from investors qualified accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increase of the Minimum Price for purchasing Samba and Keeri Samba Paddy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Paddy Marketing Board has purchased Nadu, Samba and Keeri Samba paddy at per kg price of Rs.120/-, Rs. 125/- and Rs.132/- respectively during the Yala season 2025. The Price Committee appointed by the Secretary, Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation has recommended that it would be appropriate to increase the existing minimum prices for the purchase of Samba and Keeri Samba with the aim of promoting the cultivation of these paddy varieties in the coming seasons. The Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation having informed the Cabinet that the Food Policy and Security Committee has decided to continue to maintain the minimum purchase price of 1 kg of Nadu paddy with prescribed standard at Rs.120/-, and to increase the minimum purchase price of 1 kg of Samba paddy with prescribed standard from Rs.125/- to Rs.130/- and the minimum purchase price of 1 kg of Keeri Samba paddy with prescribed standard from Rs.132/- to Rs.140/-, and it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet for the same.

description: Procurement of Food Items (Fresh, Dry Rations and Others) for the Tri-Forces for the Year 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under the National Competitive Bidding Procedure for the procurement of food items (raw, dry rations and others) to the Tri-Forces for the year 2026. 5,274 bids have been submitted by 34 bidders for 1,219 procurement packages for the Sri Lanka Army, 454 procurement packages for the Sri Lanka Navy and 242 procurement packages for the Sri Lanka Air Force. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to award the relevant procurements to the substantially responsive lowest bidders, based on the recommendations of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Programme of Providing Relief for the Disaster Affected Cultivations of Pepper, Coffee and Cardamom
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The necessary instructions have been issued by now through the Budget Circular Nos. 08/2025 and 08/2025(i) for the provision of relief to the farmers for short term crops damaged due to the sudden disaster situation caused by the adverse weather condition. Taking into account the economic importance of the export agriculture sector, the need to provide relief for the re-cultivation of long-term export agricultural crops damaged by the disaster has also been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to pay a maximum of Rs. 425,000/- per hectare to farmers engaged in the cultivation of pepper, coffee and cardamom damaged by the disaster to re-cultivate such crops and to provide saplings free of charge for the gap filling and re-cultivation of such crops through the programmes of the Department of Export Agriculture, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of Boards of Management to streamline the organization   and administration of sports complexes belonging to the Department of Sports Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Sports Development has planned to implement a project called 'Creating a Sports Culture' during the years 2025 - 2027 with the aim of popularizing sports. Under this, it is expected to develop mainly identified stadiums and indoor stadiums across the island, and to develop school playgrounds and public playgrounds across the island. As a result of the proposed project, it is planned to use the sports complexes of the Department of Sports Development to further improve the skills of emerging players technically and to enable them to engage in daily training activities. The proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to establish a Board of Management consisting of five members who will work voluntarily, for each sports complex to streamline their development and administration, maintenance and security so that they could be used more effectively and provide a wide range of service, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Surveyor General
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. N.K.U. Rohana, presently serving as the Surveyor General, is scheduled to retire from the Public Service on 2026-01-31 upon reaching the compulsory age of retirement. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to appoint Mrs. P.K.L.S. Panduwawala, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Surveyors Service, currently serving as the Additional Surveyor General (Central), to the vacant post of Surveyor General, with effect from 2026-02-01.

description: Amending the Motor Traffic (Driving Licence Levy) Regulations No. 03 of 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The issuance of temporary driving licenses in this country based on driving licenses issued in foreign countries was carried out at the Office of the Department of Motor Traffic located in Werahera, and the same function has also been started through a service counter of the Department of Motor Traffic established at the Bandaranaike International Airport from 2025-08-03. The Motor Traffic (Driving Licence Levy) Regulations No.03 of 2022 made under the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act (Chapter 203) has proclaimed the fee charged for the issuance of such temporary driving licenses. However, since the fee of Rs.2,000/- is not sufficient for providing the necessary facilities at the Bandaranaike International Airport by the Department of Motor Traffic, having opened a counter there, the need has been identified to update the fee to suit the services provided and amend the Regulations related thereto. Accordingly, the Regulations for introducing the revised levy have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2463/04 dated 2025-11-17. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new Act for the National Lotteries Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Lotteries Board was established under the Finance Act No. 11 of 1963. Having found the need to amend the said Act, which was enacted about 62 years ago, to suit the current needs of the lottery market, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2017-02-14 to draft a new Act for the purpose. Accordingly, further amendments to be made by the National Lotteries Board to the preliminary Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman have been identified. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to expeditiously complete the preparation of the Bill for the National Lotteries Board, incorporating the proposed new amendments as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Term Contract for the procurement of (04 shipments) of 2,800,000 ± 5% barrels of Murban Crude Oil
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited from the registered suppliers of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation for the purchase of 2,800,000 ± 5% barrels of Murban crude oil for a period of four months from 2026-04-15 to 2026 08 14. Five (05) suppliers have submitted bids for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee regarding the said bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the term contract for the purchase of 2,800,000 ± 5% barrels of Murban crude oil (04 shipments of 700,000 ± 5% each), to M/s. Vitol Asia Pte. Ltd. of Singapore, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing 350 housing units for the Sri Lanka Police from the ‘Harbour View Residencies’ housing project constructed by the Urban Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority has implemented the 'Harbour View Residencies' housing project, consisting of 14 floors with 452 housing units, at Cyril C. Perera Mawatha, Colombo 13, with the aim of providing housing units to officers serving in government and semi-government institutions. With the aim of providing adequate houses to officers serving in the Police Divisions in Colombo and its suburbs in the Western Province and to obtain efficient and quality service from them, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to purchase 350 housing units from the said housing project for the Sri Lanka Police and to have adequate parking facilities constructed for those houses by the Urban Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the printing and supply of vehicle number plates for the Department of Motor Traffic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under the National Competitive Procurement Procedure for the printing and supply of vehicle number plates to the Department of Motor Traffic. Four (04) bids have been submitted for the same. Based on the recommendations made by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board regarding the relevant bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the procurement for the printing and supply of vehicle number plates to the Department of Motor Traffic for a period of 05 years, to M/s South Asian Technologies (Pvt) Ltd, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the Construction of Underpass Bridge at Mahaiyawa on Kandy Jaffna Road (A-009)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under the National Competitive Procurement Methodology for the procurement of the construction of a concrete underpass bridge under the railway line at Mahaiyawa on Kandy Jaffna Road (A-009). 03 bids have been submitted for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the relevant contract to M/s. NEM Construction (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs. 699.58 million (excluding VAT), based on the recommendation given by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluation of the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Project for Building a Resilient High-Quality Maize-Based Food System for an Enhanced Thriposha Programme in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The World Food Programme is supporting the enhancement of the Thriposha Programme as part of its national nutrition interventions in the country. Accordingly, the World Food Programme has prepared a project proposal to implement a project titled ‘Sow and Grow: Building a Resilient High-Quality Maize-Based Food System for an Enhanced Thriposha Programme in Sri Lanka’ with the aim of improving the quality of maize used for Thriposha production and strengthening the Thriposha supply chain. Approximately 7,500 small and medium-scale maize farmers in Anuradhapura, Monaragala and Badulla Districts will be benefitted under the proposed project and the Korea International Cooperation Agency provides a Grant of US$ 10 million for the entire project. The proposed project is expected to be implemented during the period 2025-2029. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment to sign the relevant Record of Discussion and Terms of Reference pertaining to the implementation of the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Public-Private Partnership Model for the expansion of Haemodialysis Services in Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although dialysis services are currently available in 80 Government hospitals, it has been observed that the existing facilities are inadequate to meet the increasing clinical demand. Taking into account the difficulties faced by kidney patients due to the same, the need to expand dialysis services has been identified. For this purpose, based on the experience gained from the system already implemented at the National Hospital, Kandy, the Ministry of Health and Mass Media has planned to identify a suitable methodology for dialysis in the identified Government hospitals under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model. Under the proposed model, it is expected that the operation and management of dialysis machines, reverse osmosis systems and essential consumables will be fully financed and managed by the private partner, and the Government will provide the infrastructure while retaining the overall clinical oversight. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to take necessary action to implement the Public-Private Partnership methodology to expand haemodialysis services in the selected Government hospitals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the service of major diagnostic equipment under a Public-Private Partnership Model on a Performance-Based Payment Model
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The current demand for high-quality diagnostic services in the Sri Lankan public health system is increasing due to the growth of non-communicable diseases and the need for comprehensive services at all health care levels. However, it has been observed that patients have to face difficulties due to the unavailability of equal access for all patients in obtaining reports from major equipment such as CT scanners, MRI scanners, DSA, Cath Labs and automated haematology and biochemistry analyzers. In particular, it has been found that patients have to wait on long waiting lists due to the limited facilities available in Government hospitals to obtain such reports, resulting in delays in clinical management. Further, considering the financial constraints for the purchase of such equipment and the complex procurement procedures to be followed for the purchase and maintenance of such machines, the need to seek alternative methods for obtaining such reports has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to take necessary action to obtain the equipment required for the relevant diagnostic services, following the due procurement procedure under an appropriate Public-Private Partnership model, subject to a performance-based payment model, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for Investment proposals for economically productive utilization of State-Owned Bungalows
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2024-12-09, decided to appoint an Officials’ Committee to submit recommendations for identification of a suitable methodology for the economically productive utilization of bungalows and related premises used as official residences by the former Ministers as well as underutilized houses and premises owned by the Government. Through the Report submitted by the said Officials' Committee, it has been recommended to utilize the said bungalows for Embassies, International Organizations, Diplomatic purposes, Government and Government Affiliated Institutions as well as High-end Restaurant/Boutique Hotels and for more productive investment projects. Accordingly, it has been planned to provide initially identified 24 bungalows for the implementation of productive utilizations under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model for a period of 30 years based on their locations, in a manner that does not create social concerns. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to invite Expressions of Interest from interested investors in order to identify suitable investors for this purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Strategic Action Plan to Monitor and Combat Human Trafficking - 2026-2030
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has signed and ratified the United Nations Convention against Transnational Organized Crime (UNTOC) and its supplementary Palermo Protocol to prevent, combat and prosecute human trafficking (with particular emphasis on offenses against women and children). Accordingly, the National Anti-Human Trafficking Task Force was established in 2010 to coordinate institutions actively involved in and interested in preventing human trafficking. The said Task Force has been operating in accordance with Action Plans prepared for specific timeframes and the last National Strategic Action Plan for the period 2021-2025 expired on 2025-12-31. Therefore, the National Strategic Action Plan for the period of 2026-2030 has been prepared consisting of four pillars: Prevention, Protection, Prosecution and Partnership having reviewed the progress of the said Action Plan, and with the consent and awareness of all relevant stakeholders. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence for the implementation of the said National Strategic Action Plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Memoranda of Understanding between Sri Lankan Universities and Foreign Universities with the objective of academic collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- It has been recognized that it is essential to establish higher educational collaborations with Foreign Universities for the Sri Lankan Universities to climb up in global ranking and for internationalization. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to enter into Memoranda of Understanding, between the Sri Lankan Universities and Foreign Universities as follows for a period of five years, was approved by the Cabinet.

Memorandum of Understanding between the Bhikshu University of Sri Lanka and the Mahamakut Buddhist University in Thailand, on conducting collaborative research, and academic workshops and conferences, with the objective of enhancing academic and cultural activities among Faculties and students.


Memorandum of Understanding between the Bhiksu University of Sri Lanka and the Nalanda Institute in Jakarta, Indonesia, with the objective of enhancing academic cooperation in the fields of education, research and community service, obtaining the expert knowledge of education specialists and lecturers, utilizing physical resources such as laboratories and libraries, developing human resources through training programmes including internship training and academic conferences and supporting curriculum development .


Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo, Sri Lanka and the SGH Warsaw School of Economics, Poland, with the objective of conducting joint research and launching publications in mutually agreed areas, organizing joint conferences and workshops, facilitating staff and student exchanges and exchanging academic information and materials.
